intro.value: A campsite by the Hraunborgir service centre in Grímsnes, near the Golden Circle and about an hour from Reykjavík, with a swimming pool, hot tubs, sauna, restaurant, bar, TV lounge and playground.

season.note: In summer the service centre is open 09:00–21:00 on weekdays and until 23:00 at weekends (tjalda.is). Winter service-centre hours: Unconfirmed.

winter.value: Open all year (tjalda.is). Its own site says 'Open this winter' and advertises winter camping for campervans and motorhomes, with hot tubs, shower access and a TV lounge; the site manager helps with access to the facilities. Not on ferdalag.is's camper winter service list (checked 2026-11-04).

items.label: Lodging tax per unit per night
Winter seasonal pitch (1 Sep 2026 – 15 May 2027)
items.note: For leaving a caravan in place all winter; electricity charged by usage; limited pitches.

electricity.value: Yes – 'electrical hook-ups' (1,800 ISK per night). Number of hook-ups: Unconfirmed.

kitchen.note: No guest kitchen is listed; the campsite page lists outdoor sinks for washing up, and there is a restaurant and bar on site.

showers.value: Yes – campsite guests have access to showers during their stay. Whether a fee applies: Unconfirmed.

dump_station.value: 'Waste disposal for mobile homes' is listed by tjalda.is. Not mentioned on the operator's own pages; exact location: ask on arrival.

laundry.value: Washing machine and dryer at the service centre

camping_card.note: Not stated in the sources checked.

practical.value: Online booking on the operator's site shows the total price before you pay; tjalda.is also lists drop-in.
The swimming pool, hot tubs and sauna are at the service centre next to the campsite; whether pool entry is included in the camping fee: Unconfirmed.
EV charging is listed by tjalda.is.
